scoring_justification: Paper-reported numeric gold values for each (R, tau, surface) condition are not tabulated; the checker verifies the expected qualitative trends (peak existence, proximity to 1 at small R, impossible condition filtering) consistent with the paper's stated results.

outputs.description: Ratios of total free energy and total mass between metastable and equilibrium drops for each (temperature, dividing_surface, R) condition.
Local property ratios and chemical potential difference for each (temperature, dividing_surface, R) condition.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares selected rows (R=2,5,10,15 at τ=0.55 and 0.89 for equimolecular and moments-of-forces surfaces) to pre-extracted reference values with a 5% relative tolerance, and also validates qualitative trends (presence of a maximum, decrease to zero, coincidence at very small R).

steps.description: Verify E_ratio and m_ratio trends: very close to 1, peak at intermediate R, approach 1 for smallest R.

checks.range: E_ratio and m_ratio between 0.99 and 1.01 for non‑tension surfaces
checks.peak_location: Maximum occurs at R between 3 and 8 and does not exceed 1.003
checks.small_R: At R=1 both ratios lie in [0.999, 1.001]

steps.description: Verify local property ratios: peak at intermediate R, small‑R coincidence, correct surface combinations.

checks.peak: theta_ratio, pi_ratio, sigma_ratio each have a maximum at R between 3 and 12
checks.small_R: At R=1 theta_ratio and pi_ratio within [0.99, 1.01]
checks.surface_combos: tau=0.55 only equimolecular and moments_of_forces; tau=0.89 includes tension surface
